Author: Originaljsx
Name: More Macros
Description: Stores as many macros as you like outside the game's 100 slots and runs them through the game's own macro engine with /mm <name>. Macros can be longer than 15 lines and can have per-job variants that share one name, so a single hotbar button does the right thing on every job.
Punchline: Unlimited macro slots, with no 15 line limit.
